chronological.assumption: Known twins come from the same account with no deliberate style change. Chronological halves come from different periods.
chronological.split: Per account, first and second halves ordered by timestamp, then hand ID.

precision_at_k_scope.precision_at_k_mutual_rank: Apply the report threshold, sort by ascending mutual rank and descending score, then apply the report cap.
precision_at_k_scope.precision_at_k_mutual_rank_unfiltered: Same order across all eligible pairs, without the threshold or cap.
precision_at_k_scope.precision_at_k: Descending score across all eligible pairs, without the threshold or cap.

chronological.precision_at_k_ties: Break ties by ascending account names. Each result is null if fewer than K pairs are available.

parity.assumption: Known twins come from the same account with no deliberate style change. Parity halves share the same period.

precision_at_k_scope.precision_at_k_mutual_rank: Apply the report threshold, sort by ascending mutual rank and descending score, then apply the report cap.
precision_at_k_scope.precision_at_k_mutual_rank_unfiltered: Same order across all eligible pairs, without the threshold or cap.
precision_at_k_scope.precision_at_k: Descending score across all eligible pairs, without the threshold or cap.

parity.precision_at_k_ties: Break ties by ascending account names. Each result is null if fewer than K pairs are available.
